1.why: The interface uses a clean, highly legible sans-serif typeface with clear character separation and generous line spacing.

2.why: Instructions are presented in clean sentence case without italics, all-caps formatting, or dense text blocks.

3.why: The application is laid out in a responsive mobile-friendly container with ample margins and well-organized vertical spacing.

4.why: All text is brief, direct, and composed in simple plain language devoid of complex technical terminology.

5.why: Input fields feature clear placeholder text showing expected formats like 'name@example.com' and 'Example: 123456'.

6.why: Every screen contains only concise one- or two-sentence instructions, eliminating long reading blocks.

7.why: There are no copy-to-clipboard buttons or features provided for copying codes or text.

8.why: No QR codes or visual scanning options are present in any of the displayed setup steps.

9.why: Input fields use standard form controls that facilitate browser autofill and password manager functionality.

10.why: Clear step banners at the top and prominent primary blue buttons make the current step and main action obvious.

11.why: Each screen isolates a single primary task and presents one prominent call-to-action button.

12.why: Status messages in green banners clearly confirm completed actions and instruct what to do next.

13.why: A 'Send a new code' option is provided and incorrect entries can be retried without penalty or lockout.

14.why: The red error banner objectively states that the code did not match and suggests checking the numbers or requesting a new code.

15.why: Messages explicitly encourage users to proceed 'when you are ready' with no visible countdown timers or reading limits.
